description: Run a spot-only FX backtest using historical policy-rate-differential and/or lagged momentum signals. Downloads complete histories, verifies vintages and price coverage, and charges opening, rebalancing and closing costs. The carry signal does not include funding income or broker rollover. Access: API key required, else returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: Base currency, 3-letter ISO code. Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

event_gated.description: When true, allow positions only after verified historical policy publications for either currency. This does not use future calendars or trade before a release.

event_window_days.description: Additional calendar days after the first UTC decision following publication; 0 permits that first day only.

momentum_lookback.description: Momentum lookback in observations for the momentum signal.

quote.description: Quote currency, 3-letter ISO code. Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

transaction_cost_bps.description: Per-side transaction cost in basis points applied on position changes.

name: fx_backtest_task
title: FX Backtest
